name: Vaya Mountain Lodge St. Zeno
beschreibung: The Vaya Mountain Lodge St. Zeno is located in the center of Serfaus, just a few minutes' walk from the cable car station. The lodge blends stylish, alpine-inspired interiors with a calm ambiance made for relaxation. Guests can enjoy comfortably appointed rooms, breakfast options, and a dedicated wellness area complete with sauna and relaxation zone. Access to the top-tier Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski and outdoor resort is quick and convenient on foot or by lift.
